translations.text: He comforts us in all our afflictions, so that we too can comfort those who share in all our afflictions, with the comfort we ourselves receive from God.
To some, a fragrance of death leading to death; to others, a fragrance of life leading to life. And who is equal to these things?
We have this confidence through Christ toward God.
Not that we are capable of thinking anything as though it came from ourselves, but our ability comes from God.
For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ our Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
For God, who said that light should shine out of darkness, has himself shone in our hearts, so that we may be enlightened with the knowledge of God’s glory in the face of Jesus Christ.
For if we, while alive, are handed over to death for Jesus’ sake, then the life of Jesus will also be revealed in this mortal body of ours.
So death is at work in us, but life in you.
For God was in Christ, reconciling the world to his majesty. He did not count their sins against them, and he entrusted the message of reconciliation to us.
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were appealing to you through us. On behalf of Christ, then, we plead with you: be reconciled to God.

Look at this very sorrow you experienced for God’s sake: how much earnestness it produced in you, what a defense of yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what love, what zeal, and what a demand for justice! In everything you showed yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
Now finish doing what you wanted to do, so that just as you were eager to want it, you may also complete it in practice, according to what you have.
For through the proof given by this service, they glorify God because you have submitted to the confession of Christ’s good news and have shared generously with them and with everyone.
But whoever boasts should boast in the Lord.
Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, and by proclaiming God’s good news to you free of charge?
I robbed other churches, taking support from them to serve you.
The truth of Christ is in me: this boast of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.

Look, I have become foolish in my boasting, but you forced me to it. You ought to have spoken in my favor, because I was in no way inferior to those most distinguished apostles, even though I was nothing.

Look, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not burden you, because I do not seek what is yours, but you. For children are not obligated to store up treasures for their parents, but parents for their children.

I told you before, and I tell you beforehand again, just as I told you both times I was with you. Now, while I am away, I also write to those who sinned and to all the others: if I come again, I will not spare anyone.
